characters.summary: Stelios is an elite Spartan hoplite warrior who relies on fierce hand-to-hand combat, spear-and-shield tactics, and fearless aggression in close quarters.

sources.supports: Basic character context and appearance as a Spartan warrior in the film 300.

characters.summary: Subotai is a skilled Hyrkanian thief, archer, and swordsman who combines ranged accuracy with agile melee skirmishing.

sources.supports: Subotai's role as Conan's companion, thief, and archer.

characters.summary: The T-1000 is an advanced prototype Terminator constructed of mimetic polyalloy, allowing it to liquefy, reshape its limbs into edged weapons, and rapidly regenerate from ballistic and physical trauma.

mechanisms: Immunity to conventional firearms and physical trauma

weaknesses: Extreme cold causing temporary structural freeze
limitations: Integrity is compromised by extreme molten temperatures.

sources.supports: T-1000 capabilities, mimetic polyalloy nature, and vulnerabilities.

feats.claim: Reform after being shattered by liquid nitrogen and a gunshot.

notableResults.note: Overpowered the T-800 in hand-to-hand combat before being destroyed by molten steel.

campaignTags.claim: The T-1000 is a liquid metal cybernetic organism/machine.

unknowns: Full operational limits in extreme chemical baths.

characters.summary: The T-800 Cyberdyne Systems Model 101 is a humanoid cyborg infiltration unit featuring a hyperalloy endoskeleton covered in living tissue, possessing immense physical strength and tactical processing capabilities.

techniques: Firearm proficiency with heavy and small arms

weaknesses: Damage to power core (hydrogen fuel cells)
Severe physical trauma capable of destroying endoskeleton
limitations: Powered by a nuclear/hydrogen cell that can fail under heavy structural damage.

sources.supports: T-800 endoskeleton, capabilities, and design details.

feats.claim: Lifts and throws heavy industrial machinery and opponents.

notableResults.note: Destroyed the T-1000 using a grenade launcher to push it into molten steel.

campaignTags.claim: Living tissue over a cybernetic metal endoskeleton.
Cybernetic organism controlled by an internal computer processor.
Designed as an infiltration unit with living human tissue.

unknowns: Long-term energy reserves without external maintenance.

characters.summary: Beatrix Kiddo, aka The Bride, is an elite assassin trained in various global martial arts and swordplay, possessing extreme pain tolerance and mastery of the Five Point Palm Exploding Heart Technique.

techniques: Five Point Palm Exploding Heart Technique

mechanisms: Extreme pain tolerance and mental focus

weaknesses: Vulnerable when physically trapped or buried
limitations: Relies on human physical stamina and standard recovery.

sources.supports: The Bride's training under Pai Mei, Hattori Hanzo sword, and lethal techniques.

feats.claim: Defeats dozens of Crazy 88 swordsmen in single combat.
Escapes live burial by breaking out of a wooden coffin.

notableResults.note: Defeated O-Ren Ishii in a traditional garden sword duel.
Killed Bill using the Five Point Palm Exploding Heart Technique.

campaignTags.claim: Wields a master-crafted Hattori Hanzo steel sword.

unknowns: Exact limits of recovery from specialized neurotoxins.

characters.summary: The Professor (Sergio Marquina) is a criminal mastermind and strategist who specializes in elaborate, highly detailed heist planning, psychological manipulation, and contingency management rather than direct combat.

sources.supports: The Professor's role as the criminal mastermind and planner.

campaignTags.claim: Designs complex multi-layered heist plans and communication networks.

characters.summary: Thulsa Doom is a charismatic cult leader and sorcerer who commands fanatical followers and possesses the supernatural ability to transform into a giant serpent.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to decapitation by steel weapon
limitations: Physical body remains vulnerable when caught off guard.

sources.supports: Thulsa Doom's sorcery, snake cult leadership, and serpentine transformation.

feats.claim: Transforms into a giant python during confrontation.

notableResults.note: Beheaded by Conan with the Atlantean sword.

campaignTags.claim: Demonstrates serpentine transformation and dark sorcery.

unknowns: Full extent of magical combat spells outside of transformation and hypnosis.

characters.summary: Trinity is a master hacker and martial artist inside the Matrix, capable of defying standard physical limits through digital code manipulation, firearms proficiency, and motorcycle navigation.
weaknesses: Bound by the rules of the simulation unless overriding code
limitations: Physical body in the real world remains vulnerable while jacked into the Matrix.

sources.supports: Trinity's combat skills, hacking abilities, and feats in the Matrix.

feats.claim: Performs suspended kick mid-air ("bullet time" opening sequence).

notableResults.note: Overwhelmed by Agents in sustained encounters.

unknowns: Limits of reality manipulation outside simulated environments.

characters.summary: Ujio is a fierce traditional samurai warrior and master swordsman dedicated to Katsumoto, utilizing precise katana strikes and strict bushido combat discipline.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to ranged firearms if caught at a distance
limitations: Relies entirely on physical weapons and traditional armor.

sources.supports: Ujio's role as a master samurai warrior in the film.

feats.claim: Engages multiple opposing imperial soldiers in skilled sword combat.

notableResults.note: Fought to a stalemate in a practice wooden sword duel.

campaignTags.claim: Fights effectively on horseback as a mounted samurai.

unknowns: Performance against modern mechanized military hardware.
